# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

She has kind, old arms that she uses to comfort others. When nursing her husband in the dusk, she held his hand in her work-hardened one.

_Sources: [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001), [v3 c40 P14](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0014)_

## Personality

Capable, hardworking, and managing, Rachel is a notable housewife who readily attends to her own household and her neighbors' concerns. She prides herself on always speaking her mind without fear or favor and is known for being outspoken, opinionated, critical, and a meddlesome gossip. She dearly loves to be asked for advice and is a red-hot, enthusiastic Liberal politician. Despite her sharp tongue and tendency to nag, she is a kind, good Christian woman who never shirks her share of work and serves as a tender, patient nurse when caring for her sick husband.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 c18 P41](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0041), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived for many years at Lynde's Hollow in Avonlea with her meek husband, Thomas, keeping a sharp eye on everyone passing by. When the Cuthberts adopted Anne Shirley, Rachel criticized Anne's looks and provoked a fiery temper outburst, though she later admitted her mistake and grew fond of her. After Thomas fell ill, she served as a tender and patient nurse until his death. Following his passing, financial difficulties forced the sale of their farm, leading Rachel to accept Marilla Cuthbert's invitation to move into Green Gables to live together. There she helped Marilla raise the twins, Davy and Dora, and tried to bring them up properly. Over the years, she traveled to Four Winds for Christmas, gifted hand-made cotton-warp quilts for Anne's wedding, and spent her old age continuing her quilt-knitting for Anne's daughters while occasionally warning Anne about household matters.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v2 c10 P12](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0012), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007), [v4 c2 P4](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0004), [v4 c15 P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v5 c1 P7](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0007), [v5 c3 P6](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0006)_
